is our primary focus.
​
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
​
You may pay your taxes online or over the phone. Credit/Debit Card Payments are accepted (2.4% or $1.95 minimum convenience fee).
You may print or view (on your phone or computer) your paid receipt to show at the license bureau.
​
Original t ax statements are mailed in early November of the current year. Please review your statements to verify that all information is correct,
including mailing address.
All tax payments are due by December 31 of the current year and become delinquent on January 1. Mailed tax payments MUST have an official US Post Office postmark on or before December 31 to avoid penalties and interest. To avoid penalties and interest, please make your tax payment before December 31.

Stone County Collector of Revenue Anna Burk was appointed to serve Stone County in that capacity on March 4, 2021, beginning her first term as your Collector. Prior to being appointed Collector of Revenue, Anna served as Deputy Collector for eighteen years. Anna is excited to continue to bring you the many services that benefit all taxpayers and taxing entities of Stone County.
